source_row.rationale: Unexplained hyponatremia in a client with lung cancer, without direct tumor invasion of relevant organs, may represent a paraneoplastic syndrome (such as SIADH), in which the tumor produces substances (like ectopic hormones) causing systemic effects distant from the primary tumor site.
source_row.source_detail: Concept and Recognition of Paraneoplastic Effects
